court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J. and G. Arul Murugan, J.)
appellants: A. Rajaraman Managing Director, Carmiya Industries Private Limited
respondents: Indian Bank, Rep. by its Authorized Officer
advocates: For Petitioner: Mr. R. Surya Prakash
prayer: Prayer: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for issuance of a writ of certiorari calling for the records of the impugned order passed by the Debt Recovery Appellate Tribunal at Chennai in I.A. No. 183/2026 in AIR No. 196/2026 dated 10-3-2026 and quash the same as illegal.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the writ petition with liberty to avail appropriate remedy, in accordance with law.

2. In view of the same, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn, with the aforesaid liberty. There will be no order as to costs. Consequently, WMP No. 16876 of 2026 is closed.
